title: A Study of Ozanimod in Pregnant Women With Ulcerative Colitis and Their Offspring
official: ZEPOSIA® (Ozanimod) Ulcerative Colitis Pregnancy Registry: a Prospective, Observational Study on the Safety of Ozanimod Exposure in Pregnant Women With Ulcerative Colitis and Their Offspring
summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate association between ozanimod exposure during pregnancy and subsequent maternal, fetal, and infant outcomes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Currently or recently pregnant
* Diagnosis of UC
* Resident of country where ozanimod is prescribed for the treatment of UC

Exclusion Criteria:

* Exposure to other S1P therapies at any time during pregnancy

Other protocol-defined eligibility criteria apply.
